content.title: About
content.content: Coconut cream, canned, sweetened is a thick, creamy product made from coconut flesh, water and sugar. It is used as an ingredient in desserts, drinks and sauces, giving them a distinct coconut aroma and sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Coconut cream has a higher fat content (about 20‑25 %) than coconut milk.
The sweetened version often contains cane sugar or corn syrup.
Canned cream can be stored at room temperature until the jar is opened.
It is a popular vegan substitute for dairy cream in many recipes.
In some countries it is a traditional ingredient for sweet sauces and curries.

items.title: Rich in medium‑chain triglycerides
items.content: MCTs are easily digested and can provide a quick source of energy.

items.title: Contains vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of iron and magnesium
items.content: These minerals support blood formation and normal muscle function.

items.title: Supports skin health
items.content: Fatty acids help moisturize and repair the skin barrier.

items.title: Lactose‑ and gluten‑free
items.content: Suitable for people with lactose intolerance and celiac disease.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Sweetened cream can raise blood glucose levels; people with diabetes should limit intake.

items.title: Coconut allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to coconut products.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Coconut cream is calorie‑dense, so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Most of the fat is saturated; those with cardiovascular concerns should consume it in moderation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add coconut cream to smoothies, cocktails, desserts, baked goods and sauces. It is used as a dairy‑free cream substitute in vegan recipes and for making ice cream, puddings and tropical drinks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened jar in a cool, dry place. After opening, keep it refrigerated and use within 5‑7 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or changes color.
